about: Section 16, frozen from the published text (2026-10-17): each unit is a claim, with the words it rests on; a key is a list of alternatives, every key must appear in one paragraph of the draft. Alternatives are added only when a trace calls the new word equivalent. A list's items are keys where an item carries the point; Joel's list rulings (2026-10-03, 10-07: "when there's no actual need for 3 items you can remove one of them") let an item that matters least go, recorded in the draft's fixes file. His order (U6) is his stated position of 2026-10-16 23:38 UTC, every step a key. A unit a dedup cut moves to an earlier section says so in the draft's fixes file, with the section that carries it (Joel 2026-10-17: "you can only cut if it isn't losing important meaning or there's no good way to merge").

units.what: most community projects begin in the wrong order, land first
with the vision in a document
ownership concentrated because somebody had the money
emotional preparation deferred until everyone has more time
the better order is less cinematic
Joel's order (2026-10-16 23:38): practice together, process a real conflict, clarify values, test membership, decide ownership and exit, then consider land
the economic path should be staged the same way
a cluster of cooperating households can first take basic internal life out of purchase while outside earners contribute a defined share

words: no money exchanged between members for basic community functions
elsewhere.why: repeats r1 item 4: the first stage is section 4's, in Joel's own words

units.what: it moves to a common purse only after it can provision members reliably and allocate the common fairly
reducing or eliminating outside money should come from demonstrated ability
not from declaring money impure while somebody else quietly pays the tax bill
most readers have a job, children, pets, debt, a mortgage, a sick parent, or several of these arranged in a circle; Joel's list rule (10-03, 10-07) lets an item that matters least go
fine: the most important pl/ork does not require land
people sometimes buy forty acres and then import every kilogram of their unprocessed material to a more scenic location
the view improves; the conflict acquires goats
inner pl/ork can begin where you live
peer counseling needs two people and enough privacy to speak
reparenting, somatic practice, jealousy processing and conflict repair do not wait for a deed
a weekly group that has practiced together for two years already contains a real piece of community

elsewhere.section: # Your Little Forming Group Already Is the Community

units.what: it may never own land, and it can still change how people survive divorce, illness, grief, parenting and ordinary loneliness
remote or constrained readers can build the portion available
hold a weekly meal with two households
arrange a counseling exchange with one friend, in person or by video
share tools, childcare, transport, food preparation or a sauna
add acro-yoga, dance improvisation, a mothers' circle or a cuddle puddle if you're hippie enough
three households reliably showing up for one another for six months will teach you more than another year of imagining the ideal village
the first month without the heroic land purchase
units.note_v1: 2026-10-17, v1: the dedup inside the section (repeats r1 item 10): "without the heroic land purchase" was the fourth time that land can wait; H1-P2 and H2-P1 carry it, and the heading says "This Month"

units.what: start the inner pl/ork: read the free reparenting guide and Hearthwork manual, or begin with another serious practice you already trust
practice before you have an audience
find two or three people, and call it a practice group rather than a commune
meet regularly; learn to listen, switch roles, handle one disagreement and keep commitments before discussing a shared future
places to meet people: unprogrammed Quaker meetings, restorative-practice groups, open-hearted congregations, mature recovery communities, meditation groups
and people who came back from a long retreat kinder rather than more impressed with themselves
visit actual communities: Twin Oaks, East Wind, Acorn, other intentional communities and many ecovillages receive visitors
read their current visitor requirements first
visits teach you what no manifesto can
how much togetherness you enjoy, which forms of privacy you need, what labor system irritates you, and whether communal showers feel liberating or make you start pricing studio apartments
look before you leap: it will save you time and money (Joel's own words of 2026-10-17 13:11 UTC for the published "do those three things before you spend serious time or money looking for land")

units.what: community tends to gather wherever people experience real care, play, usefulness and room to become more honest
the Bruderhof shaped his father
his father made a film, founded a research organization and carried him through communal experiments

maybe somebody will build something useful from it; maybe that community will teach somebody who builds another
the transmission does not require one institution, one founder or one official version
if you build something real, maybe we'll hear about each other
if you teach other people to build, hearing about it matters less
